info.title: Listen Labs Public API — Study Data
info.description:
Retrieve studies, responses, transcripts, and questions from Listen Labs. Authenticate with an `x-api-key` header (contact support@listenlabs.ai to request a key). Each API key is scoped to a single organization.

Endpoints for creating and launching studies are described in a separate spec: https://docs.listenlabs.ai/api-v2/openapi.yaml

Full documentation: https://docs.listenlabs.ai

get.description: Lists all studies in the API key's organization.
Lists all responses for a given study.

parameters.name: link_id
parameters.description: The link ID of the study. You can find this in the study URL (e.g. in `https://listenlabs.ai/s/abc123` the link ID is `abc123`) or via the List Studies endpoint.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of responses to return per page.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date string to filter responses updated after this date (e.g. `2023-08-18T11:51:54.649916Z`).

parameters.name: include_in_progress
parameters.description: Whether to include responses whose analysis is still in progress.

200.description: A list of responses for the given study.

get.description: Retrieves a single response for a specific study, including the full interview transcript with audio/video links where available.

parameters.name: link_id
parameters.description: The link ID of the study.

parameters.name: response_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the specific response to retrieve.

200.description: The response with its full transcript.

get.description: Retrieves all questions for a specific study, from the study's latest revision.

parameters.name: study_id
parameters.description: The link ID of the study to retrieve questions for. You can find it in the study URL or via the List Studies endpoint.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key scoped to a single organization. Contact support@listenlabs.ai to request one.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found in the caller's organization.

id.description: Permanent unique identifier for the study.

link_id.description: The link ID of the study. Editable in study settings, so it might change.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the study was created.

desc.description: A description of the study, e.g. "My study (10 Responses)".

response_number.description: The ordered number of the response.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the response was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the response was last updated (uses the analysis completion time when available).

progress.description: The completion progress of the response (e.g. "complete", "in_progress").

response_duration_seconds.description: The total duration of the response in seconds.

answers.description: Answers to all questions of the study, keyed by question text. Includes a "Summary" key with a summary of the entire conversation.

answers_array.description: Answers to all questions of the study as an array.

attributes.description: URL parameters that were passed to the study, e.g. `id` from `https://listenlabs.ai/s/abc123?id=123`.

short_transcript.description: A transcript of the entire conversation where the assistant messages are shortened to a couple of words. Null if the transcript has not been generated yet.

short_assistant_messages.description: Condensed assistant turns used to build compact transcript context.

bullet_summary.description: Concise bullet-point summary of the response.

quality_score.description: Numeric response quality score, typically on a 1-5 scale.

tags.description: Extracted keyword labels for the response.

tagline.description: Short one-line synthesis for the response.

summary.description: A natural-language summary of the response. May be omitted when a summary has not yet been generated.

answer_id.description: The answer ID. Matches the `answer_id` on transcript rows from the single response endpoint, enabling cross-referencing.

discussion_guide_question_id.description: The discussion guide question ID. Matches the `id` field from the Get Study Questions endpoint, enabling you to join answers with their question definitions.

concept_id.description: The concept ID. Null if not concept-specific.

question.description: The question text, prefixed with its number when available (e.g. "Q1: What is your age?").

survey.description: The link ID of the survey this response belongs to.

transcript.description: A complete transcript of the conversation.

discussion_guide_question_id.description: The discussion guide question ID for this row. Matches the `id` field from the Get Study Questions endpoint.

concept_id.description: The concept ID for this row. Null if the question isn't concept-specific.

answer_id.description: The answer ID for this question. Matches the `answer_id` in the list endpoint's `answers_array`. Null for non-question rows (e.g. intro messages).

response_index.description: The zero-based index of this row in the conversation history.

is_followup.description: Whether this row is a follow-up to the same question as the previous row.

audio.description: A signed URL to the audio recording of the user's response, if available. Valid for 1 hour. Null if no audio recording exists.

video.description: Video playback information, if available. Null if no video recording exists.

stream_url.description: HLS stream URL for the video recording.

mp4_url.description: Direct MP4 download URL for the video recording.

id.description: Unique identifier for the question. Matches the `discussion_guide_question_id` field in the response endpoints.

text.description: The question text shown to participants.

is_screener.description: Whether this question is part of the screening section.

question_number.description: The human-readable question number for display purposes.

concepts.description: Concept objects attached to this question (empty if the question is not part of a concept test block).

is_multi_select.description: Multiple choice only: whether the participant can select multiple options.

options.description: Multiple choice and ranking only: the list of answer options or items to rank.

name.description: The file name of the media.

url.description: The URL of the media file.

embed_url.description: An optional embed URL for the concept (e.g. a Figma or prototype link).
